name: Fractured Fractals
summary: This EA trades fractal breakout patterns, entering positions when price breaks above or below Bill Williams' fractal levels. It uses fractal highs and lows as dynamic support/resistance zones and executes trades on confirmed breakouts with built-in stop loss and take profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于分形突破模式交易，当价格突破比尔·威廉姆斯分形的高点或低点时入场。它使用分形高低点作为动态支撑阻力区域，在确认突破后执行交易，并内置止损和止盈管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于比尔·威廉姆斯分形指标，识别局部高点或低点作为关键支撑阻力位。入场条件为价格向上突破前一分形高点时做多，向下突破前一分形低点时做空，属于经典突破策略。出场条件依赖预设的止损止盈比例，止损设在分形另一侧，止盈根据风险回报比设定。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位计算方式。资金管理方面，策略依赖分形结构的有效性，但缺乏对虚假突破的过滤机制，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' Fractal indicator, identifying local highs and lows as key support and resistance levels. Entry conditions trigger a buy when price breaks above a previous fractal high and a sell when price breaks below a previous fractal low, constituting a classic breakout approach. Exit conditions rely on predefined stop loss and take profit ratios, with stops placed on the opposite side of the fractal and take profit set according to a risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or account-balance-based proportional calculation. Money management depends on the validity of fractal structures, but the strategy lacks a false breakout filter mechanism, making it prone to frequent whipsaw signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets.

pros: 分形突破逻辑清晰，基于经典技术分析理论，容易理解和验证
使用动态的支撑阻力位而非固定价位，能自适应市场波动变化
内置止损止盈机制，每笔交易都有明确的风险控制边界
pros_en: Fractal breakout logic is clear and based on classic technical analysis theory, easy to understand and verify
Uses dynamic support/resistance levels instead of fixed price levels, adapting to market volatility changes
Built-in stop loss and take profit mechanism provides defined risk boundaries for each trade
cons: 缺乏震荡行情过滤器，在非趋势市场中容易遭受频繁虚假突破导致的连续亏损
分形信号具有滞后性，突破确认时价格往往已经走了相当一段距离
未考虑交易成本和滑点影响，在高频交易环境下止盈可能无法覆盖点差成本
cons_en: Lacks a ranging market filter, prone to consecutive losses from frequent false breakouts in non-trending markets
Fractal signals are inherently lagging, price often moves a significant distance by the time breakout is confirmed
Does not account for trading costs and slippage, take profit may not cover spread costs in high-frequency environments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或均线方向），仅在趋势明确时交易分形突破，减少震荡市假信号
加入成交量确认或K线形态确认机制，提高突破信号的有效性和胜率
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or moving average direction) to trade fractal breakouts only in confirmed trends, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Incorporate volume confirmation or candlestick pattern confirmation to improve signal validity and win rate

risk_points: 缺乏震荡市过滤机制，可能导致连续止损
分形信号滞后性可能使入场价位不够理想
risk_points_en: Lack of ranging market filter may lead to consecutive stop losses
Fractal signal lag may result in suboptimal entry prices
